name: Her Name Is Olgra

faq.answer: Olgra fell in battle against the quilboar. The healer who saved Mankrik could not save her, and he intends to honor her memory forever.

aliases: what are the adornments made of
faq.answer: Olgra's adornments are cherished pieces of jewelry made from polished bone. She wore them before she was slain.
The Razormane raiders have Olgra's ornaments. Mankrik sends you to recover them from the raiders near the place where she died.
faq.q: Why are the Razormane raiders being hunted?

aliases: what will mankrik do with the adornments
why does mankrik want the adornments
faq.answer: Mankrik plans to place the recovered bone jewelry beside the monument he is building for Olgra, so her memory will endure.
faq.q: What will Mankrik do with the recovered adornments?

sections.body: A healer saved Mankrik, but Olgra died from her wounds on the battlefield. Grieving, Mankrik prepares a lasting tribute so her name and sacrifice will be remembered.
sections.title: Honoring the Fallen

sections.body: Olgra wore cherished ornaments made of polished bone, but they are missing from her resting place. Mankrik asks you to recover them from the nearby Razormane raiders, so they can rest beside the monument he is raising for her.
sections.title: Lost Keepsakes

summary: Mankrik mourns Olgra and prepares a monument to keep her name alive. He asks you to seek her missing bone adornments among the nearby Razormane raiders.
attribution: In-game quest text: Her Name Is Olgra
